tools.title: Set InnerSpace Project Unit

tools.description: Discover UniFi InnerSpace tools (floor plans, walls, wall types and device placement from UniFi InnerSpace) through the compact tool index. The catalog is manifest-backed in lazy mode; in meta-only mode it starts with registered meta-tools and expands after domain modules execute. Standard MCP clients should prefer tools/list when it exposes the needed tools.
tools.name: innerspace_tool_index

category.description: Filter to one category. Valid values are returned in the 'categories' field of every response.

include_schemas.description: Include full input/output schemas per tool. Defaults to false — set true with a name, category or search filter to get parameter details for specific tools.

name.description: Exact, case-sensitive tool name. Cannot be combined with category or search. Unknown names return an empty index.

search.description: Case-insensitive token search over tool names and descriptions. Ignores common words and one-character terms; multi-word queries require at least half of usable terms (minimum two). Terms of four or more characters also match token prefixes. Results are ranked by exact phrase and name matches, with at most 20 returned. An empty string applies no filter; a non-empty query with no usable terms returns no tools.

categories.description: All available category names (use as values for the category filter)

filtered.description: True when name, category or search filter was applied

tools.description: Matching tools with name and description (plus schemas if include_schemas)

confirm.description: When true, re-reads, sends one request and reads the change back; if the outcome is unknown, read before retrying. When false (default), returns a preview from a fresh read.

coordinates.description: 'frame' (default): the frame the reads return, from the plan's top-left, y down, in unit; refused on a plan whose image is shifted or scaled. 'plan_units': the console's own stored values.

objects.description: Attenuation objects to update, at most 100: each names its id and only the fields to change. points replaces the whole polygon; variant "custom" takes an attenuation_object_type_id. Each object is sent whole from a fresh read, so an edit made elsewhere to the same object after that read is overwritten; an object that is gone or moved to another plan is refused and nothing is sent.

unit.description: Unit of every length and coordinate in this call: 'metric' (metres) or 'imperial' (feet). Required, so a change of the project's unit cannot rescale a call.
